user.title: IR Learning Hub
user.description: Select a ZHA IR transmitter detected in Home Assistant. If your device is not listed, choose manual setup.

data_description.zha_device: A ZHA device exposing the supported IR control cluster.
data_description.learn_timeout: How long, in seconds, learning mode stays active.
data_description.learn_reassert_interval: How often, in seconds, learning mode is reasserted while waiting for a code.

manual.title: Manual transmitter setup
manual.description: Use this only when automatic ZHA discovery does not list your IR transmitter.

generate_code.name: Generate code
generate_code.description: Generate a sendable IR code from a protocol description (e.g. Sony SIRC) without learning it from a remote. Returns a code you can test and save.

protocol.name: Protocol
protocol.description: IR protocol to generate. Currently sony_sirc.

command.name: Command
command.description: Protocol command code (e.g. 18 for Sony Volume Up).

device.name: Device
device.description: Protocol device/address code (e.g. 16 for a Sony receiver).

bits.name: Bits
bits.description: SIRC frame length: 12, 15, or 20. Defaults to 12.

extended.name: Extended
extended.description: Extended byte for 20-bit SIRC. Ignored for 12/15-bit.

repeats.name: Repeats
repeats.description: How many times the frame is sent. Sony needs at least 3. Defaults to 3.

carrier_frequency.name: Carrier frequency
carrier_frequency.description: Optional carrier override in Hz. Defaults to the protocol value (40000 for Sony).

save_command.name: Save command
save_command.description: Save or replace an IR command in the registry.

source.description: Optional provenance object for non-learned commands, e.g. the output of generate_code. Stored as-is and never sent.
